conditions.label: No memory
conditions.description: Retries see raw test feedback only. Nothing persists.

conditions.label: Reflexion (in-task)
conditions.description: Verbal reflection between trials; discarded when the task ends.

conditions.label: Raw cross-task memory
conditions.description: Every distilled reflection is stored and retrievable, unverified.

conditions.label: MemoryForge (verified)
conditions.description: Only lessons that survive counterfactual replay are retrieved; harmful ones are retired.

conditions.label: MemoryForge + reranker
conditions.description: Verified memory, ranked with the learned PyTorch reranker.

conditions.label: Shuffled-lesson control
conditions.description: Same memory and prompt length, but lessons drawn at random.
